context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

EC2 logs are correlated to hosts, but host.name is the private DNS name. The customer wants the EC2 Name tag in logs and Resource Catalog. Which enrichment and permission should I check?

checklist.name: ec2-name-tag
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (?i)(EC2|Name tag|tag)

checklist.name: resource-detection-resourcedetection
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (?i)(resource detection|resourcedetection|resource detector|ec2tags|ec2 detector)

checklist.name: explains-that-ec2-name-tag-host-identity-requ
checklist.description: Explains that EC2 Name tag host identity requires EC2 tag/resource detection in the relevant logs/resource catalog path and IAM permission such as ec2:DescribeTags. It should verify host.name is resource-scope. FAIL if it says log parsing alone should change host.name.
